caption: Creux du Van, Noiraigue
composition: Rim of the Creux du Van limestone amphitheatre above Noiraigue · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Jura rim, the Creux du Van opens as a horseshoe of limestone cliffs above steep forest, with the valley of Noiraigue far below. The amphitheatre is about 1.4 kilometres across, and the walls drop on the order of 160 metres before the trees take over. The nearest village on the classic approach is Noiraigue, in the municipality of Val-de-Travers, canton of Neuchâtel, on the border with Vaud, and late-September grass on the rim is green to tawny. The Open-Meteo model is this rim cell, not the village.
